name: White Tower of Thessaloniki
description: Landmark Ottoman fortress & former prison  housing an interactive exhibition of the city's history.

name: Aristotelous Square
description: Vast, waterfront public square, designed by Ernest Hebrard & surrounded by mansions & cafes.

name: Arch of Galerius
description: Iconic monument dedicated in 303 CE featuring relief scenes of Galerius' victory over the Persians.

name: Thessaloniki Waterfront
description: Seaside boardwalk with water gardens & sports courts, backed by storied monuments & concert halls.

name: Holy Cathedral Church of Hagia Sophia
description: Historic, iconic orthodox church with elaborate statuary, paintings & mosaics under massive arches.

name: Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki
description: Noted archaeological museum with a massive collection of Greek art & artifacts up to late antiquity.

name: Museum of Byzantine Civilization
description: Byzantine history & culture museum with architectural relics & art, plus public art classes.

name: Roman Forum of Thessaloniki
description: Ruins of a 2nd-century Roman forum with a restored amphitheater & excavated corridors & arches.

name: Rotonda
description: Circular building built as a house of worship by Romans in the early 300s & known for its mosaics.
address: Platia Agiou Georgiou Rotonta 5, Thessaloniki 546 35, Greece

name: Eleftherios Venizelos Statue
description: White marble statue depicting the Greek statesmen often called "The Maker of Modern Greece."

name: Vlatadon Monastery
description: Hilltop Byzantine temple with city views, centuries-old frescoes, icons & religious treasures.

name: Alexander the Great Statue
description: Giant monument depicting lauded Ancient Greek ruler Alexander III of Macedonia on a rearing horse.

name: Kanoula
description: Snug spot with eclectic decor offering Mediterranean cuisine including many vegetarian options.

name: Charoupi
description: Simple, warm eatery offering traditional Cretan & Greek plates alongside local wines.

name: L'Albero
description: Steak, seafood, risotto & pasta dishes in elegant surroundings, plus a courtyard terrace.

name: Electra Palace Thessaloniki
description: Refined lodging offering elegant rooms & suites, plus a rooftop eatery, a posh bar & 2 pools.

name: ON Residence, Small Luxury Hotels of the World
description: Chic quarters, some with bay views, in a genteel hotel offering a restaurant & a rooftop bar.

name: THIRTYNINE
description: Modern hotel featuring contemporary rooms & suites, some with balconies, plus a terrace & a gym.

name: No 15 Ermou Hotel
description: Trendy hotel offering a bar, a restaurant & an exercise room, plus a sauna & a steam room.

name: The Met Hotel
description: Sleek rooms & suites in an upscale modern hotel offering chic dining, a spa & a rooftop pool.

name: S Hotel Boutique Thessaloniki | Luxury Hotel
description: Polished rooms & suites with balconies in an upmarket hotel featuring archaeological ruins & dining.

name: Pedion Areos
description: Nature area by the bay, with fish ponds, birdhouses & turtles, plus a kids' playground & cafe.

name: Pasha’s Gardens
description: Quirky park with mysterious, half-ruined stone structures dating to the early 20th century.

name: Seyh Su
description: High woodland overlooking Mt. Olympus, with snake eagles & cuckoos nesting in pines & cypresses.

name: Elaiorema
description: Dog-friendly park with trails for hikers & cyclists, plus a basketball court & exercise equipment.

name: Horseshoe of Aristotelous
address: Τ.Σ. ΑΡΙΣΤΟΤΕΛΟΥΣ ΤΕΡΜΑ ΠΕΤΑΛΟ, Thessaloniki 546 24, Greece
